sentence: Trim the rose of Sharon shrubs in the backyard.

observation.model_notes: Both photos are extreme macro close-ups of a single rose of Sharon flower bloom (white petals with a magenta/crimson eye and cream-colored stamen column). Neither photo shows any part of the shrub's overall form — no branches, canopy, height, spread, or surrounding yard context (fences, house, other plants) are visible, and no indication of which yard section the plant is in beyond the customer's stated location. As a result these photos cannot support scoping shrub_trimming (no way to judge plant size, overgrowth, or how many shrubs are involved) or confirm access/hazards. A wider, medium-distance photo of the shrub(s) in place would be needed to scope this job.

service_lines.uncertain: Both photos are extreme macro shots of a single flower bloom, not the shrub itself. No branch structure, plant height/spread, or shrub count is visible, so quantity and size cannot be determined from these images.

supporting_evidence.note: Close-up of a white rose of Sharon flower with magenta center; blurred green foliage in background, no shrub form visible.
Close-up of a similar rose of Sharon flower with a visible bud beside it; again only foliage in soft background, no shrub structure visible.

evidence.note: Flower macro shot confirms rose of Sharon species but gives no view of the shrub to assess trimming needs.
Second flower macro shot, same limitation — no shrub structure shown.
